architectureDecision.decision: Strengthen the private Control Center inside Smarter Justice as a legal-portal-only coordination layer.
rationale: Roger expressly limited this builder to Smarter Justice and its separate legal micro-portals.
Dedicated legal portals retain their own repository, domain, deployment, artifact, continuation prompt, safeguards, and public identity.
The Control Center coordinates metadata and evidence rather than confidential public-user matters.
architectureDecision.migrationApproach: Preserve legacy API aliases temporarily, filter out all non-legal sector records, expose legal-portal routes, and mark compatibility exports deprecated.
